title.ja: 正規稀少尾の通常importance sampling
title.en: Ordinary importance sampling of a normal rare tail

summary.ja: 通常の尤度比平均を解析モーメント・独立seed分散・有限被覆診断で確認。
summary.en: Check ordinary likelihood-ratio averages with analytic moments,independent batch variance and finite coverage diagnostics.

algorithm.ja: Y=1(X>a)exp(-aX+a²/2)の通常平均。ランダムな重み総和で割らず、proposal調整なし。直接MCの無hitは0のまま保存しCP区間を付けます。
algorithm.en: Ordinary mean ofY=1(X>a)exp(-aX+a²/2),without random weight normalization or proposal tuning. Retain direct zero-hit counts with Clopper-Pearson intervals.

validation.ja: 1〜4次モーメントを独立正の積分で資格。既知分散による5SE校正、seed間分散、解析分散低減、重み欠落負例。既知分散normal95%のIS区間の被覆は閾値/prefixごと64反復で別記。
validation.en: Qualify moments1..4 by independent positive quadrature. Gate known-variance5SE,batch variance,analytic variance reduction and omitted-weight negative control. Report known-variance normal95IScoverage separately for64trials per threshold/prefix.

limits.ja: 重み付きISへBernoulliの厳密区間を転用しません。64反復は一般95%被覆の証明でなく、nestedprefixを独立反復へ水増ししません。global weightESSと事象ESSは別です。
limits.en: Bernoulli exact intervals are not applied to weighted IS.64trials do not prove general95%coverage;nested prefixes are not extra independent replicates. Global weightESS and eventESS are distinct.

review_level.ja: 著者一次章の選択箇所＋独立モーメント積分
review_level.en: Selected author-primary exposition plus independent moment quadrature

references.author: A. B. Owen
references.title: Monte Carlo theory,methods and examples,Chapter9: importance sampling

review.ja: 準備時に著者版9章のsupport・通常IS平均・2次モーメントと重み診断の選択箇所を確認。今回の再取得は403。全書籍やPERT実験を再現しません。
review.en: Selected author-chapter support,ordinary estimator,second moments and diagnostics were read during preparation. Current refetch returned403. No full-book or PERT experiment reproduction.

caption.ja: 保存した実データ由来の分布・誤差診断。空間次元と標本/時間軸を区別します。
caption.en: Distribution and error diagnostics from actual saved data;sample/time axes are distinguished from spatial dimensions.

metrics.scope: Known-moment calibration and finite repeated-interval coverage. Neither nominal intervals nor their64trial coverage is a deterministic bound/general95%coverage proof. Ordinary IS weights have no random denominator.

scope.ja: 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。
scope.en: These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.
